title: Fundamental Limits of Decentralized Self-Regulating Random Walks
summary: We study self-regulating random walks (SRRWs), a decentralized mechanism for maintaining a stable population of mobile tokens on a graph. Tokens move by random walks, may be lost at faulty or malicious trap nodes, and may be locally forked or terminated according to node visit ages. The goal is to prevent both extinction and runaway growth without a central coordinator. We develop a graph-aware, controller-agnostic theory for SRRWs on finite connected graphs with lazy reversible random-walk dynamics.
